messages:
maya (ml-infra): CI is red on master — multiple prompt-output golden tests failing after the serialization refactor. Job: https://ci.redwood/internal/12345
Samir: which tests exactly?
maya (ml-infra): tests/prompt_outputs/check_prompt_serialization_test.py::test_prompt_stability and a couple of snapshot files under tests/goldens/prompt_outputs/*.golden
PJ: can you paste the diff for one of them?
maya (ml-infra): here —
```diff
- expected: \"{\\\"prompt\\\": \\\"Hello\\\", \\\"meta\\\": {\\\"lang\\\": \\\"en\\\"}}\"
+ actual:   \"{\\\"meta\\\": {\\\"lang\\\": \\\"en\\\"}, \\\"prompt\\\": \\\"Hello\\\"}\"
```
maya (ml-infra): Looks like key ordering changed (we switched to deterministic JSON in PR #4021). Also saw differences where trailing newline got added for some prompts.
Samir: ok that smells like ordering + whitespace normalization. Do we want to update the golden loader to canonicalize before compare, or revert the serialization change?
PJ: prefer making tests resilient. Golden matcher should load JSON and compare semantically, not bytewise.
maya (ml-infra): Agreed. For now can we get a CI rerun to confirm it isn't a flaky noise?
ci-bot: Triggering rerun for job 12345 (requested by maya (ml-infra))...
ci-bot: Rerun started — queued on linux-6 (runner-42)
devops-bot: FYI, serialization refactor landed in commit abcdef1 (merge PR #4021).
Samir: I'll try a quick bisect to find the exact commit that introduced the behavior. Running: `git bisect start HEAD v2026-02-28` and `git bisect run pytest tests/prompt_outputs/check_prompt_serialization_test.py::test_prompt_stability`
Samir: (update) bisect points to commit abcdef1 — the deterministic JSON change + escape-unicode flag.
PJ: thanks. Plan: implement a small change in the golden loader to do `json.loads` on both sides and compare `==` (or use deepdiff for stable order). That avoids needing to update ~50 goldens.
maya (ml-infra): good. Could you also normalize trailing whitespace/newlines after deserializing? We've seen `\n` appended in a couple places.
PJ: yes. Will open a PR with tests that canonicalize both actual and expected before compare. Will include a note: "golden matcher: compare parsed JSON + trim trailing newline".
Samir: after PJ's PR, we should rerun the full prompt-output suite. Happy to run a local pass before pushing.
maya (ml-infra): if PR lands today can we ask a CI priority rerun? This is blocking a couple release branches.
PJ: will target today. Quick PR description and changelog entry included.
ci-bot: Rerun finished: job 12345 — FAILED (same snapshot mismatch) — rerun job 12346 queued by ci-bot
PJ: I pushed a WIP branch `golden-json-compare` (refs/heads/golden-json-compare). Samir, can you `git pull` and run the failing test locally with: `pytest tests/prompt_outputs/check_prompt_serialization_test.py::test_prompt_stability -q`?
Samir: pulled and ran — local pass after applying my local workaround (strip trailing newline).
maya (ml-infra): can you update PR to include a short migration note for Dedicated customers? We changed serialization semantics in PR #4021 so if anyone persisted raw serialized prompts they may see ordering differences when diffing.
PJ: will add note. Also adding a small script `tools/goldens/normalize_golden.py` to help update goldens if needed (with dry-run flag).
maya (ml-infra): perfect. Once CI goes green on the WIP PR we'll merge and cut a fastfix to release branch. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
devops-bot: ci job 12346 passed — prompting full-suite run on master to confirm (scheduled)
ci-bot: Full prompt-output suite started (job 12400)
ci-bot: Full suite finished — ALL PASS ✅
maya (ml-infra): marking this resolved for now. Follow-up: add a test in CI that runs the canonical JSON-compare for goldens to catch serialization drift.
PJ: will add a lint/test hook in the PR. Closing thread once PR merged.
